next.reason: Both add the value of each addend into the sum counter by arithmetic-statement rules (§2023:13.18.54.4 GR6 'the value added is that of the corresponding sum counter' for a sum-counter operand; §2023:13.18.54.4 GR9 multiple addends summed separately). The size-error result differs: 1985 says only 'This addition is consistent with the rules for arithmetic statements', i.e. an addition with no SIZE ERROR phrase, where per §1985:VI.6.4.2 'the values of the affected resultant identifiers are undefined'. §2023:13.18.54.4 GR3 makes it 'consistent with the general rules of the ADD statement with the ON SIZE ERROR phrase' and 'Each addition is tested for size error; if a size error occurs, the EC-REPORT-SUM-SIZE exception condition is set to exist' (sum counter left unchanged, size error indicator set). An undefined run-time result became a defined one; no compile-time refusal is involved.
